title: What's New: Enhanced Financial Analytics (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Enhanced Financial Reporting and Demo Data

features.name: Deferral Reports with Subtotals
features.description: Excel layout deferral reports for GL, purchase, and sales now include subtotals. Previously released in fall 2025 without subtotals, now shipped out of the box with subtotals included.
features.status_evidence_quote: we're also shipping in Business Central out of the box the deferral reports with subtotals included

features.name: Performance-Tuned Trial Balance Reports
features.description: Trial balance reports and trial balance previous year reports have been performance tuned to run much faster. These new tuned reports are initially placed under a feature management flag.
caveats: Feature management flag allows rollback to old behavior at least for this release wave and possibly the next one

features.name: Out-of-Box Analysis Views for Finance
features.description: Analysis views can now be shipped out of the box with the application. Out-of-the-box analysis views are shipping for GL registered and fixed asset ledgers pages. Available in 28.X, not yet in the April release.
features.status_evidence_quote: These are shipped in 20 eight dot X, so they're not in the April release yet, but they will come very soon.
caveats: Not yet available in April release, coming in 28.X

features.name: Copilot Analysis Assist for Finance Reports
features.description: Users can copy descriptions of desired analysis or reports into Copilot Analysis Assist, which will generate custom finance analysis views and reports. Useful for analyses that require specific account filtering.
caveats: Requires manual description of desired analysis; some analyses require specific chart of accounts filtering

features.name: Enhanced Demo Data for Fixed Assets
features.description: New demo data added for fixed assets including transactions data for acquisitions and depreciations. Allows better demonstration of all fixed asset reports out of the box.
caveats: Only covers acquisitions and depreciations scenarios
